items.title: EU to Support Libya in the Fight Against Terrorism and for Border Security
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The European Union’s ambassador to Libya, Nicola Orlando, met yesterday in Tripoli with members of the 3+3 Joint Military Committee, which brings together representatives from Tripoli and Benghazi under the auspices of the Ministry of Defense and the General Command of the Libyan Arab Armed Forces. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: Kenya: Ruto, Oburu Lead Broad-Based Parliamentary Retreat in Naivasha Ahead of 2027 Election
items.description: [Capital FM] Naivasha -- President William Ruto and Orange Democratic Movement (ODM) Chairman Oburu Oginga are leading a broad-based parliamentary retreat in Naivasha attended by more than 250 National Assembly members and 45 senators, a year ahead of the 2027 General Election.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Ruto, Oburu Lead Broad-Based Parliamentary Retreat in Naivasha Ahead of 2027 Election

items.title: Kenya: Matiang'i - Differences Within Opposition Are Part of Democracy
items.description: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Jubilee Party Presidential candidate Fred Matiang'i has sought to play down reports of divisions within the United Opposition, saying the coalition is still in the process of establishing itself before settling on who will lead it into the 2027 presidential election.

items.title: Africa: The World Has Changed. African Countries Must Rethink How They Grow Their Economies
items.description: [The Conversation Africa] The prolonged disruption of shipping through the Strait of Hormuz has exposed how vulnerable Africa's economies are to geopolitical shocks. Fuel prices have remained elevated, squeezing economies that depend heavily on petroleum imports from the Middle East. These include Ethiopia, Kenya, Mozambique, South Africa, Tanzania and Uganda.
items.titleIt: Africa: The World Has Changed. African Countries Must Rethink How They Grow Their Economies

items.title: Ambassador Del Monaco Meets with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to the Republic of Kenya and the Seychelles, Vincenzo Del Monaco, met with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya, Kamau Thugge, with whom he had “an important exchange of information.” “It was an opportunity to discuss the country’s economic situation,” the embassy noted, “and the growing bilateral relationship between Italy and Kenya.” Read article...

items.title: Congo-Kinshasa: Investigation Raises Alarm Over Uranium in DR Congo Cobalt Shipments to China
items.description: [RFI] An investigation by Lighthouse Reports, The Financial Times and Le Monde traces the possible export of uranium from the Democratic Republic of Congo back to a confidential International Atomic Energy Agency memo obtained in 2024. Chinese mining group CMOC, which owns the main site examined in Katanga, disputes the findings.

items.title: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
items.description: Pope Leo called for peace in Sudan on Sunday during an address at the Vatican. Leo singled out El-Obeid, the beseiged capital of North Kordofan state. Residents are facing a lack food, water and medical supplies as fighting in the city continues.
items.titleIt: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
